claims.verbatim: Ship Ellen Austin, French, from Liverpool April 7.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 18 May 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Ship Ellen Austin, French, Liverpool April 7, with mdse
and 786[?] passengers, to Spofford, Tileston & Co. Had heavy
westerly gales from 12th to 24th April, since then a great
deal of light winds and calms. May 6, Lawrence Doyle, the
boatswain, died of effusion of the lungs; had two births and
five deaths, three of which were children under two years.
